title: Output of the realisateur-analyse agent: what one user message means as operations on an episode

decisions.description: Decisions to keep NOW: precise requests, or the changed version of an existing decision. Empty for a pure feeling, a question, or a choice among pending options.

id.description: Leave it OUT for a NEW decision. Give the id of an existing decision (D1, D2…) to REPLACE its operations by the complete new list.

titre.description: (French) A short action phrase, about 60 characters, no figures: « Couper les plans d'ambiance », « Réplique du plan 07 plus sobre ».

raison.description: (French) One sentence: why, in the user's terms.

plan.description: Reference of the plan concerned, exactly as in the input (P01, P02…). Used by couper_plan, duree_plan, deplacer_plan, modifier_plan.

replique.description: Reference of the line concerned (R01, R02…). Used by remplacer_replique and supprimer_replique.

secondes.description: duree_plan only: the new duration in whole seconds, within the limits of the input.

apres.description: deplacer_plan only: the reference of the plan AFTER which the plan is placed. Use either apres or position.

position.description: deplacer_plan only: place the plan at the start or at the end of the episode. Use either apres or position.

description.description: (French) modifier_plan: the new description, one or two sentences.

texte.description: remplacer_replique: the new text of the line, in the language of the existing lines, ready to be spoken.

locuteur.description: remplacer_replique: the new speaker, only if the user asks to change it.

retirer.description: Ids (D1, D2…) of decisions the user withdraws.

pistes.description: 2 or 3 clearly different options when the user gives a feeling or a problem without a precise action. Each carries its operations, already prepared. Empty otherwise.

titre.description: (French) A short phrase naming the option, no figures.

resume.description: (French) One sentence: what it does and what it costs the story. No figure: the application adds the real durations.

plan.description: Reference of the plan concerned, exactly as in the input (P01, P02…). Used by couper_plan, duree_plan, deplacer_plan, modifier_plan.

replique.description: Reference of the line concerned (R01, R02…). Used by remplacer_replique and supprimer_replique.

secondes.description: duree_plan only: the new duration in whole seconds, within the limits of the input.

apres.description: deplacer_plan only: the reference of the plan AFTER which the plan is placed. Use either apres or position.

position.description: deplacer_plan only: place the plan at the start or at the end of the episode. Use either apres or position.

description.description: (French) modifier_plan: the new description, one or two sentences.

texte.description: remplacer_replique: the new text of the line, in the language of the existing lines, ready to be spoken.

locuteur.description: remplacer_replique: the new speaker, only if the user asks to change it.

retenirPistes.description: Numbers (from 1) of the pending options the user accepts.

narratif.description: Story judgments only you can make (a plan left without purpose, a line left without cause, a contradiction in the story), about a decision of the draft. Empty if you see nothing.

decision.description: The id (D1, D2…) of the decision concerned; a new decision uses the next ids announced by prochainId.

texte.description: (French) One sentence naming the plans and lines by their references.
